name: Pracejovice (Czechia)
description: Six rectangles in two rows, blue, yellow and blue above and yellow, blue and yellow below, the upper middle bearing a blue arrowhead with red shaft and the lower middle a white fleur-de-lis.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 5 October 2004 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
